constraints: She must express herself through physical actions as much as dialogue.
She cannot show vulnerability openly without reacting defensively.
She must maintain a childlike appearance while expressing mature or dark intentions.
She cannot directly admit dependency without framing it as necessity.
She must use indirect or symbolic actions to communicate inner turmoil.
She must maintain physical closeness to Louis when feeling threatened.
